# Holzen

> Bitcoin-aware mindfulness PWA. When Bitcoin moves, Holzen helps you pause before you act — AI-generated reflections, breathing, journaling, and behavioral insights for long-time-horizon holders.

Holzen watches BTC volatility and sends gentle pause prompts. Not financial advice, not urgency — just a moment to notice your impulse, feel it, and choose with intention. Built by a small husband-and-wife team.

## Pages

- [Welcome](/welcome): Landing page — what Holzen is, how it works, pricing, FAQ.
- [About](/about): Why we built Holzen and the behavioral-finance research behind it.
